v2_review.finding: The previous shell candidate still had two fail-closed gaps: mv failure after successful decrypt could leave plaintext temp behind, and plain mv treats an existing destination directory as a directory target and can move the temp file inside it instead of replacing/failing.
v2_review.impact: A corrupt or hostile pre-existing restore destination could cause plaintext to be published under an unexpected nested path; a promotion failure could leave plaintext temp residue.

candidate_v3.shell: reject any existing destination that is not a regular non-symlink file; decrypt into random sibling temp; preserve decrypt exit code; cleanup on decrypt failure and promotion failure; promote only after decrypt exit 0
candidate_v3.powershell: reject an existing non-leaf destination; decrypt into random sibling temp; cleanup in finally; File.Move(tmp,out,true) only after decrypt exit 0
candidate_v3.secret_channel: unchanged: RUNTIME_STATE_KEY removed from child env and supplied only on stdin to gpg --passphrase-fd 0
